transcription.raw_text:
CHAPTER 3

A PUZZLE BOX, A MAGNIFYING GLASS, & THE MYSTERIOUS EGG

Joy Is in the Details

"In photography, the smallest thing can be a great subject. The little human detail can become a Leitmotiv." —HENRI CARTIER-BRESSON

"With a keen eye for details, one truth prevails!" —GOSHO AOYAMA

Japan is a culture alive with details. The Japanese take an immense pride in being exacting in their art, engineering, and service. These qualities are so much of what makes Japan special and why once I finally visited, I almost never returned home.

It was late 2018, and a few months prior, I'd hit a creative wall. After working for several years in the music industry, the grind had worn me down. My joy was gone. I still loved music, but I was exhausted, and I needed a vacation badly. A friend of mine, who happened to be visiting from out of town, suggested I go to Japan.
